name: FriRSS
description: FriRSS is a modern, self-hosted, customizable web frontend for FreshRSS. It provides a desktop interface and mobile PWA, full-text extraction, offline reading, multiple languages, themes and extensive interface customization.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent FriRSS data, including the SQLite database.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port used to access the FriRSS web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the FriRSS process runs as. Unraid uses 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the FriRSS process runs as. Unraid uses 100 (users).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, for example Europe/Zurich or America/New_York. Leave empty to use UTC.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public URL of your FriRSS instance, for example https://rss.example.com.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Optional Redis connection URL for shared caching.

variables.name: Cache Sync Interval
variables.description: Background sync interval in minutes, for pre-filling the cache with no browser open. Requires the Redis URL above: without it, this value does nothing. Set 0 to disable.

variables.name: FreshRSS Internal Host
variables.description: Set this if FreshRSS runs on a private address - 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, or a container name on a shared Docker network. FriRSS blocks private targets by default so that a logged-in user cannot aim it at your NAS, your database or a cloud metadata endpoint; listing your FreshRSS host here allows that one address. Comma-separated. Leave empty when your FreshRSS URL is public. Without it, connecting fails and the container log shows: POST /api/proxy 403

variables.name: Proxy Rewrites
variables.description: Optional. Rewrites a public FreshRSS URL to an internal one, as from=to, comma-separated. Useful when FriRSS and FreshRSS share a Docker network: it cuts the round trip through your reverse proxy. Hosts listed here are trusted automatically.
